annotations.title: Trace a transfer through a mixer, exchange or swap service

description: Follow one transfer through a mixer, a privacy pool, an exchange or an instant-swap service to its likely other side, on Solana, Tron, the EVM chains and Bitcoin: for a deposit, where it most likely came out; for a withdrawal, where it most likely went in. Give the wallet and the signature (transaction hash) of a transaction where it sent money to, or received money from, a mixer, an exchange or a swap service (analyze_address and get_connections list them). Returns ranked candidate wallets, each with a confidence and the transactions behind it, and one verdict line; a link is exact when it can be confirmed, and a ranked lead otherwise. Most deposits into an exchange are just deposits, and the verdict says so. With hops 2, a deposit is traced as a private swap through two exchanges, such as a Houdini Swap route. The chain is read from the wallet's address (pass chain for an EVM chain other than Ethereum). Costs 1 trace (or 3 pack credits), or without an API key $0.25 paid per call with x402; refunded (never settled) if it fails. Results are leads, not proof.

chain.description: The transfer's chain, when the wallet's address doesn't say it: an EVM chain for a 0x wallet (ethereum by default).

counterparty.description: Optional: the exchange, swap service or mixer wallet (or pool contract) on the other side, when the transaction moved money with several. Iris picks the one it knows otherwise.

direction.description: Optional, with counterparty: out when the wallet paid it (a deposit), in when it paid the wallet (a withdrawal).

hops.description: Optional: 2 traces the transfer as a private swap through two exchanges, such as a Houdini Swap route. A lead, not proof. 1 (the default): one exchange.

signature.description: The transaction: a Solana signature (base58), an EVM or Tron transaction hash, or a Bitcoin txid.

wallet.description: The wallet whose deposit or withdrawal is traced (not the exchange or the mixer).
